, was a map located in a city soccer court. It was the event map for the third mission of the
. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players start with a varying amount of cash, based on the player count. It has no unique rewards.

You only got cash if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would received 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this was reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it was a decimal number, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down.
All difficulties had health scaling of 10% in trio matches and 20% in quad matches. The

was a soccer court placed in the middle of a city. The court had a green floor with white lines and was surrounded by tall metal fences on the sides and taller ones on the front and back. Behind the fences there was audience seats to sit on and bystanders watching the court. On the front and back there were stairs leading out of the court. Next to them were a few trees. These stairs lead to the city itself, which contained multiple colorful buildings with billboards on them which display Roblox ads.

The path started at one goal to the other. The path went in a straight line and entered a u-shaped portion of the path. Then it lead into two straights which lead into a loop. Out of that loop were a few remaining straight paths leading to the exit.
This map only had one preset loadout with no option to choose your own. Because of this, every player would use the following loadout.
